name: Spanish DNI / NIE
description: Spanish ID document (DNI) or foreigner ID (NIE) copy. Detects the DNI number (8 digits + letter), NIE (X/Y/Z + 7 digits + letter), the support number (número de soporte / IDESP), dates of birth and Spanish addresses, plus names. Pair with manual redaction to black out the photo and signature.

patterns.name: DNI
patterns.description: Spanish national ID: 8 digits + control letter.

patterns.name: NIE
patterns.description: Foreigner ID number: X/Y/Z + 7 digits + control letter.

patterns.name: Núm. soporte
patterns.description: Support number on the DNI: 3 letters + 6 digits, matched with its label (número de soporte, IDESP).

patterns.name: Date
patterns.description: Date of birth or expiry: DD/MM/YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY.

patterns.name: Phone
patterns.description: Spanish phone number: mobile (6/7) or landline (8/9), optional +34, not inside longer numbers.
